title: Abba Guryon of Tzidon
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mishnah Kiddushin 4:14 cites Abba Guryon of Tzidon reporting Abba Gurya. Hyman thinks he is Abba Uryan of Tzidon in the ninth introduction to Esther Rabbah, reporting five sayings of Rabban Gamliel, including “When dishonest judges multiply, dishonest witnesses multiply,” etc. Rav Pealim, page 14b, suggests he is Abba the Expositor.

notes.text: Gurya, Uryan and the further Expositor identification are presented as tentative connections. The introductory work is Esther Rabbah.

Torat Emet 357 on Mishnah Kiddushin 4:14 explicitly has Abba Guryan of Tzadyan reporting Abba Gurya. The two are different positions in the transmission chain; the proposed Uryan and Expositor connections remain tentative.
The Uryan and Expositor identifications remain conjectural; the exact Rav Pealim passage has not been independently inspected.
